description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for PDF write/transform work the skill owns — merge / split / rotate / encrypt, AcroForm fill + flatten decision, create-from-content, structured text/table extraction and OCR of a text-layer-less scan. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours (PDF→Markdown ingestion, image OCR, Word authoring, spreadsheet authoring, legal document triage) whose vocabulary overlaps.

queries.q: merge these three PDFs into one file and drop the duplicate cover page
fill this AcroForm PDF with the applicant values, then flatten it so it ships as final
split the PDF into one file per page and rotate the landscape ones
erstelle aus diesem Inhalt ein PDF und verschlüssele es mit einem Passwort
extract the tables from this PDF — OCR the pages if there is no text layer
convert this PDF to Markdown so I can read it in the repo
queries.note: PDF → Markdown ingestion, not a PDF write/transform → markitdown

queries.q: OCR this screenshot into text for me
queries.note: OCR of a standalone image, not of a scanned PDF's rasterized pages → markitdown

queries.q: generate a Word document from this template and fill in the placeholders
build me a spreadsheet model from these numbers with formulas instead of hardcoded values
review this NDA PDF and flag the risky clauses
queries.note: the PDF is only the container; the ask is legal clause triage → nda-triage
